51527383.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to human PPARgamma-LBD (206 to 477 residues)/human RXRalpha-LBD (224 to 462 residues) heterodimer assessed as dissociation constant using PGC-1alpha as coactivator peptide by isothermal titration calorimetry analysis

original_paragraph.Materials and Methods: Isothermal titration calorimetry (ITC) measurements were performed using a MicroCal iTC200 instrument (Malvern Panalytical) at 25 °C. The PPARγ/RXRα heterodimer (10 μM) was loaded into the sample cell, and the coactivator peptide (PGC-1α, 100 μM) was loaded into the syringe. The ligand (NET-TMN or RM) was titrated into the heterodimer solution. The buffer used was 20 mM HEPES (pH 7.4), 100 mM NaCl, 1 mM DTT, and 0.02% NaN3. The stirring speed was set to 300 rpm. The injection volume was 2 μL, and 20 injections were performed with a spacing of 120 s. The data were analyzed using Origin software (Malvern Panalytical) with a single-site binding model. The experiments were performed in triplicate.

Here, NET-TMN (4, b) and RM (c), agonists of RXRα and PPARγ, respectively, were added into the concentrated heterodimer samples before titration. The parameters are described in Table 2. All of experiments were performed using three replicates (N = 3), and the data are shown as the mean ± SD.

51527380.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to human RXRalpha-LBD (224 to 462 residues) expressed in Escherichia coli BL21 (DE3) assessed as dissociation constant using PGC-1alpha as coactivator peptide by isothermal titration calorimetry analysis
51527380.references_previous: Yamada, S.; Kawasaki, M.; Fujihara, M.; Watanabe, M.; Motoyama, T.; Ito, S.; Tokiwa, H.; Nakano, S.; Kakuta, H. Competitive Binding Assay with an Umbelliferone-Based Fluorescent Retinoid for Retinoid X Receptor Ligand Screening. J. Med. Chem. 2019, 62 (19), 8809–8818.

original_paragraph.Materials and Methods: The ITC measurements were performed using a MicroCal iTC200 (Malvern Panalytical) at 25 °C. The RXRα-LBD (224–462) was expressed in Escherichia coli BL21 (DE3) and purified as described previously.14 The protein was dialyzed against 20 mM HEPES (pH 7.4), 100 mM NaCl, 1 mM DTT, and 0.01% Tween-20. The coactivator peptides (SRC1, PGC-1α, and D22) were synthesized and labeled with fluorescein at the N-terminus. The ITC experiments were performed by titrating 20 μL of the coactivator peptide (100 μM) into 200 μL of RXRα-LBD (10 μM) in the sample cell. The reference cell contained buffer only. The injections were performed in 20 steps of 2 μL each, with a 120 s interval between injections. The data were analyzed using Origin 7.0 software (OriginLab) with a one-site binding model.
original_paragraph.Figure 3 caption: ITC analysis of coactivator peptide (SRC1 and PGC-1α) binding to RXRα-LBD homodimer in the presence of NEt-3IB (2, a and d), CU-6PMN (3, b and e), and NEt-TMN (4, c and f). Isotherms obtained by titrating coactivator peptides of SRC1 and PGC-1α are represented in a–c and d–f, respectively. The ITC curves obtained by titrating SRC1 (a–c) and PGC-1α (d–f) peptides into the cell were colored by salmon pink and orange, respectively. The parameters are described in Table 1. All of experiments were performed using three replicates (N = 3). In the table, the data are shown as the mean ± SD.

51527377.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to human RXRalpha-LBD (224 to 462 residues) expressed in Escherichia coli BL21 (DE3) assessed as dissociation constant using SRC1 as coactivator peptide by isothermal titration calorimetry analysis

original_paragraph.Materials and Methods: The ITC measurements were performed using a MicroCal iTC200 (Malvern Panalytical) at 25 °C. The RXRα-LBD (224–462) was dialyzed against 20 mM HEPES (pH 7.4), 100 mM NaCl, 1 mM DTT, and 0.02% NaN3. The protein concentration was adjusted to 10 μM. The coactivator peptides (SRC1 and PGC-1α) were dissolved in the same buffer. The ligands were dissolved in DMSO and diluted to the desired concentration in the buffer. The protein solution was loaded into the sample cell (200 μL), and the ligand solution was loaded into the syringe (250 μL). The titration was performed by injecting 20 μL of the ligand solution into the protein solution at 30 s intervals. The data were analyzed using Origin 7.0 software (OriginLab).
original_paragraph.Figure 3 caption: ITC analysis of coactivator peptide (SRC1 and PGC-1α) binding to RXRα-LBD homodimer in the presence of NEt-3IB (2, a and d), CU-6PMN (3, b and e), and NEt-TMN (4, c and f). Isotherms obtained by titrating coactivator peptides of SRC1 and PGC-1α are represented in a–c and d–f, respectively. The ITC curves obtained by titrating SRC1 (a–c) and PGC-1α (d–f) peptides into the cell were colored by salmon pink and orange, respectively. The parameters are described in Table 1. All of experiments were performed using three replicates (N = 3). In the table, the data are shown as the mean ± SD.
